nodes.title: SG-6.4.2 · Add onReject prop and Reject button to ExecutionPanel
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/components/ExecutionPanel.tsx already renders Approve (AWAITING_APPROVAL, onApprove) and Retry (FAILED, onRetry) and has no onReject. Desired behavior: add an optional onReject prop and a Reject button visible only for AWAITING_APPROVAL when onReject is given, calling onReject with the execution id. Expected result: Approve and Retry behave exactly as before. Why: the admin must be able to reject a publication (SG-6.4).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given status AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject provided, when the panel renders, then a button named Reject is shown
- Given Reject is clicked, when onReject runs, then it is called once with the execution id
- Given onReject is not provided or status is not AWAITING_APPROVAL, when the panel renders, then no Reject button exists
- Given the change, when Approve or Retry is clicked, then they call onApprove or onRetry with the id as before


## Scope
- In scope: onReject prop and Reject button in ExecutionPanel
- Out of scope: AdminApp wiring of onReject
- Out of scope: rejectExecution client call
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Preserve: Approve and Retry visibility and behavior
- Preserve: actionError alert rendering
- Preserve: existing panel sections


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript in game/frontend
- UI-only change, no new API


## Definition of done
- Reject button implemented per acceptance criteria
- Unit tests for the panel pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject button only for AWAITING_APPROVAL runs when onReject is given
nodes.body:
Context: ExecutionPanelProps in ExecutionPanel.tsx has onApprove, onRetry and actionError only. Desired behavior: add optional onReject?: (id: string) => void and render a Reject button inside the execution-actions container when status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and onReject is defined. Expected result: clicking it calls onReject(id). Why: lets the admin reject a pending publication.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given AWAITING_APPROVAL with onReject, when rendered, then button Reject is present and clicking calls onReject with the execution id
- Given no onReject, when rendered with AWAITING_APPROVAL, then Reject is absent
- Given FAILED or RUNNING status, when rendered with onReject, then Reject is absent
- Given AWAITING_APPROVAL, when Approve is clicked, then onApprove is called with the id and onReject is not


## Scope
- In scope: ExecutionPanel.tsx props and markup
- Out of scope: AdminApp wiring
- Preserve: Approve and Retry behavior


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the existing canApprove/canRetry pattern


## Definition of done
- Button gating matches the criteria


## Non-functional requirements
- Button is a native button with type=button for accessibility


## Clarifying questions
- None
